stories.title: Consent Service Core Logic Implementation
stories.description: Implement core business logic in consent_service for managing Tier 1 and Tier 2 consent states, including validation rules, upgrade paths, storage eligibility decisions, and enforcement of HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification requirements.
